verses.ar: «فَلِهَذَا ٱضْطَرَبَ قَلْبِي وَخَفَقَ مِنْ مَوْضِعِهِ.
verses.kjv: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.
verses.web: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

verses.ar: ٱسْمَعُوا سَمَاعًا رَعْدَ صَوْتِهِ وَٱلزَّمْزَمَةَ ٱلْخَارِجَةَ مِنْ فِيهِ.
verses.kjv: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound [that] goeth out of his mouth.
verses.web: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

verses.ar: تَحْتَ كُلِّ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ يُطْلِقُهَا، كَذَا نُورُهُ إِلَى أَكْنَافِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.
verses.web: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

verses.ar: بَعْدُ يُزَمْجِرُ صَوْتٌ، يُرْعِدُ بِصَوْتِ جَلَالِهِ، وَلَا يُؤَخِّرُهَا إِذْ سُمِعَ صَوْتُهُ.
verses.kjv: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.
verses.web: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

verses.ar: ٱللهُ يُرْعِدُ بِصَوْتِهِ عَجَبًا. يَصْنَعُ عَظَائِمَ لَا نُدْرِكُهَا.
verses.kjv: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.
verses.web: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ يَقُولُ لِلثَّلْجِ: ٱسْقُطْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ. كَذَا لِوَابِلِ ٱلْمَطَرِ، وَابِلِ أَمْطَارِ عِزِّهِ.
verses.kjv: For he saith to the snow, Be thou [on] the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.
verses.web: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

verses.ar: يَخْتِمُ عَلَى يَدِ كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ، لِيَعْلَمَ كُلُّ ٱلنَّاسِ خَالِقَهُمْ،
verses.kjv: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.
verses.web: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

verses.ar: فَتَدْخُلُ ٱلْحَيَوَانَاتُ ٱلْمَآوِيَ، وَتَسْتَقِرُّ فِي أَوْجِرَتِهَا.
verses.kjv: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.
verses.web: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلْجَنُوبِ يَأْتِي ٱلْإِعْصَارُ، وَمِنَ ٱلشَّمَالِ ٱلْبَرَدُ.
verses.kjv: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.
verses.web: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

verses.ar: مِنْ نَسَمَةِ ٱللهِ يُجْعَلُ ٱلْجَمْدُ، وَتَتَضَيَّقُ سِعَةُ ٱلْمِيَاهِ.
verses.kjv: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.
verses.web: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

verses.ar: أَيْضًا بِرِيٍّ يَطْرَحُ ٱلْغَيْمَ. يُبَدِّدُ سَحَابَ نُورِهِ.
verses.kjv: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:
verses.web: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

verses.ar: فَهِيَ مُدَوَّرَةٌ مُتَقَلِّبَةٌ بِإِدَارَتِهِ، لِتَفْعَلَ كُلَّ مَا يَأْمُرُ بِهِ عَلَى وَجْهِ ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةِ،
verses.kjv: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.
verses.web: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

verses.ar: سَوَاءٌ كَانَ لِلتَّأْدِيبِ أَوْ لِأَرْضِهِ أَوْ لِلرَّحْمَةِ يُرْسِلُهَا.
verses.kjv: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.
verses.web: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

verses.ar: «اُنْصُتْ إِلَى هَذَا يَا أَيُّوبُ، وَقِفْ وَتَأَمَّلْ بِعَجَائِبِ ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
verses.web: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

verses.ar: أَتُدْرِكُ ٱنْتِبَاهَ ٱللهِ إِلَيْهَا، أَوْ إِضَاءَةَ نُورِ سَحَابِهِ؟
verses.kjv: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?
verses.web: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

verses.ar: أَتُدْرِكُ مُوازَنَةَ ٱلسَّحَابِ، مُعْجِزَاتِ ٱلْكَامِلِ ٱلْمَعَارِفِ؟
verses.kjv: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?
verses.web: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

verses.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْخُنُ ثِيَابُكَ إِذَا سَكَنَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْ رِيحِ ٱلْجَنُوبِ؟
verses.kjv: How thy garments [are] warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south [wind]?
verses.web: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

verses.ar: هَلْ صَفَّحْتَ مَعَهُ ٱلْجَلَدَ ٱلْمُمَكَّنَ كَٱلْمِرْآةِ ٱلْمَسْبُوكَةِ؟
verses.kjv: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, [which is] strong, [and] as a molten looking glass?
verses.web: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

verses.ar: عَلِّمْنَا مَا نَقُولُ لَهُ. إِنَّنَا لَا نُحْسِنُ ٱلْكَلَامَ بِسَبَبِ ٱلظُّلْمَةِ!
verses.kjv: Teach us what we shall say unto him; [for] we cannot order [our speech] by reason of darkness.
verses.web: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

verses.ar: هَلْ يُقَصُّ عَلَيْهِ كَلَامِي إِذَا تَكَلَّمْتُ؟ هَلْ يَنْطِقُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ لِكَيْ يَبْتَلِعَ؟
verses.kjv: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.
verses.web: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

verses.ar: وَٱلْآنَ لَا يُرَى ٱلنُّورُ ٱلْبَاهِرُ ٱلَّذِي هُوَ فِي ٱلْجَلَدِ، ثُمَّ تَعْبُرُ ٱلرِّيحُ فَتُنَقِّيهِ.
verses.kjv: And now [men] see not the bright light which [is] in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.
verses.web: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلشَّمَالِ يَأْتِي ذَهَبٌ. عِنْدَ ٱللهِ جَلَالٌ مُرْهِبٌ.
verses.kjv: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God [is] terrible majesty.
verses.web: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

verses.ar: ٱلْقَدِيرُ لَا نُدْرِكُهُ. عَظِيمُ ٱلْقُوَّةِ وَٱلْحَقِّ، وَكَثِيرُ ٱلْبِرِّ. لَا يُجَاوِبُ.
verses.kjv: [Touching] the Almighty, we cannot find him out: [he is] excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.
verses.web: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ فَلْتَخَفْهُ ٱلنَّاسُ. كُلَّ حَكِيمِ ٱلْقَلْبِ لَا يُرَاعِي».
verses.kjv: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any [that are] wise of heart.
verses.web: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
